long.en:
## Notifier+
Notifier+ keeps GLPI technicians informed in real time about everything happening with tickets, changes, problems and project tasks — without refreshing the page or checking email.
### Bell icon A bell icon appears in the bottom-right corner of every GLPI page. When something important happens, the bell pulses, the counter increases and a **sound alert** plays automatically.
### 7 notification queues | Queue | What it shows | |-------|---------------| | All | Everything unread | | New | Unassigned tickets (including email/collector) | | Mine | Tickets assigned directly to me | | Team | Tickets assigned to my group | | Others | Activity on tickets I have access to (admins/supervisors) | | Resolved | Resolved tickets pending review | | Closed | Closed tickets pending review |
### Full notifications page Click **"View all"** in the bell to open a dedicated page with: - 12 columns: Ticket, №, Date/Time, Status, Priority, Entity, Requester, Type, User, Event, Detail, Actions - Filter by current ticket status and period - Grouping by ticket respecting the configured style (Priority / Combined / Multiple) - **Assume** button for unassigned tickets — assigns the technician without opening the ticket - Auto-refresh every 30 seconds
### Event coverage - New unassigned tickets (including **email/collector**) - Direct and group assignments (including nested subgroups) - Followups, tasks, solutions, status changes - **Solution refused** — technician notified when requester refuses - **Validations** — notifies approver on request, actors on response - **Entity transfer** — notifies technicians of destination entity - Private followups notify only technician assignees, never the requester
### Entity filtering Technicians only receive notifications for tickets in entities they have access to. Recursive profiles automatically expand to child entities.
### Smart cleanup - Merged/deleted tickets removed automatically from the bell - When an actor is removed from a ticket, stops receiving notifications - When a group is unassigned, members stop receiving notifications - Inactive/deleted user notifications purged periodically
### Per-user preferences - Notification types per item type and channel - Sound per queue - Message style: Priority / Combined / Multiple updates - Show/hide resolved and closed tickets - "Others" queue toggle (requires STEAL right)
### Languages Português do Brasil, English, Français, Español, Nederlands
